snippet.title: Mutation Overload - Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Check out the reveal trailer for Mutation Overload. An action-roguelike where you play a mad scientist clearing out rooms with a variety of weaponry. Smashing, shooting and slashing your way through the rooms will be made more challenging by the mutation mechanic. Allowing you to select the mutation of the next encounter, but beware, these mutations chain together. 
Mutation Overload is currently planned for PC (Steam)
